field.label: Account ID
field.help: Cloudflare account ID (32-char hex, visible on the CF dashboard).

field.label: API Token
field.help: Token scoped to Account > Account Rule Lists > Write only (Lists API).

field.label: Cloudflare list name
field.help: Named IP list that holds all WAN egress IPs (letters and digits only, no dashes). Created if missing.

field.label: Update interval (minutes)
field.help: How often to check WAN IPs against Cloudflare lists.
